name: Select (dropdown)
summary: A control that opens a list so someone can choose one option from many.

anatomy.purpose: Looks like a field, with the chosen value and a chevron.
The opened white panel with square-rounded corners.
Rows 44px tall; the selected one shows a check.

variants.name: Native
variants.use: Default choice. Best on mobile and for accessibility.

variants.name: Custom listbox
variants.use: When rows need icons or extra info.

variants.name: Searchable
variants.use: Long lists such as countries or fonts.

whenToUse: Choosing one from 5 or more options.
whenNotToUse: 2 to 4 options: use radios or a segmented control.
Navigating pages: use a menu or links.

accessibility.role: native <select>, or button with aria-haspopup=listbox plus role=listbox
keyboard: Enter, Space or Arrow Down opens it.
Arrow keys move; Enter selects; Escape closes.
Typing jumps to a matching option.
accessibility.focus: Focus returns to the trigger on close.
notes: Prefer native <select> unless rows need rich content.
Selected option needs a check mark, not just color.
Keep the arrow visible and consistent.
